title: Forward susi top to Susi Commercial Apps and remove operator_report
goal: Vision: V-10. Mandate 84. Commercial 969d7ef6 serves core's operator control surface (VC-201-099): susi-commercial top with parity shown, and its plug answers ecosystem_hub.operator.snapshot.v1. Core's susi top forwards there (naming the command when it is not installed), the operator_snapshot MCP tool's facade requests that topic (outside gemi., so scoped sessions reach it), and core removes susi-gemi operator_report.rs, its completion test, the gemi plane arm and tests/top_cli_tests.rs and tests/tui_top.rs, which commercial carries.

reuse.searched: susi_config::vault_exec::run_commercial (the forwarder eval-corpus and the vault verbs use); commercial T-CORESIZEFIX-6 for the destination.

limitations: Lands after the plug host registers ecosystem_hub.operator.snapshot.v1 (commercial T-CORESIZEFIX-6). Without susi-commercial installed, susi top names the command instead of answering. Windows x86_64 first.
